csv_project_name: Independence Go Bond FY 27 Sidewalks To Schools
csv_scope_of_work: As part of the GO Bond FY27 Sidewalks to Schools Project, the City plans to include two (2) elementary schools in the project, one of which is in the Independence School District, Blackburn Elementary School, and the other which is in the Fort Osage School District, Elm Grove Elementary School.. The project includes performing all design and construction activities, including, survey, geotechnical investigation (as necessary), traffic/pedestrian studies (if necessary), utility relocation, environmental investigations (if necessary), preparation of preliminary, right-of-way and final design plans (including legal descriptions & exhibits needed for any ROW acquisitions, if necessary), and complete construction services. The City will handle any right of way acquisitions that may be needed to construct the project with our Acquisitions staff and/or our On-Call Land Acquisition Services Providers.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Traffic Studies
